exact_text: The normative manifest parses to exactly 799 unique edge IDs: 96 canonical rows and 703 private/product rows. Parsing reaches ICL03, finds no duplicate edge ID, and finds no Markdown data-row width mismatch.
The 96-row canonical graph contains 27 symbols. Literal traversal from INBOX reaches all 27. Its exact sinks are CANCELLED, DONE, and FAILED.

Every adjacent pair in every literal canonical projection sequence is a listed canonical edge. A component event is legal only when its coordinate edge is listed and the projection is S, one canonical edge, or the exact synchronized sequence on that row.

Terminal Work states require previously committed clean receipts. DONE, FAILED, and CANCELLED are immutable; later retained risk proceeds through RemediationObligation/MAINTENANCE rather than reopening Work.

exact_text: Each reducer predicate includes ‘and no earlier priority matched,’ making the priority predicates disjoint. Unknown symbols, zero or multiple synchronized matches, illegal adjacency, or disagreement with persisted canonical_state rejects the transaction.
SAVED means evaluation continues to the next lower-priority coordinate; it is not a default result. Priority 17 is total because the candidate map enumerates every candidate symbol.

Pending cancellation with an active rollback is visible at priority 2. Work cancellation REQUESTED, QUIESCING, CLEANING, and clean CANCELLED owns priorities 3 through 6. Subordinate release-attempt cancellation maps to SAVED at priority 13 and cannot derive parent cancellation or terminality.

IX03 is the sole parent cancellation-cleanup scheduler. IX04 is the sole row that changes the improvement work cancellation coordinate CLEANING to CANCELLED, and it requires clean receipts plus no live child, authority, effect, rollback, or attempt.

IA16 and IA17 require work_cancel_state=NONE. After IX01, they reject; IA18-F accepts failure-origin FAILURE_PENDING_CLEANUP and IA18-C accepts failure-origin CLEANING in exact REQUESTED, QUIESCING, or CLEANING IX context.

IA18-F preserves the one IA07/IA08 CleanupManifest byte-for-byte, creates no cleanup, saga, or parent terminal, and advances the attempt-local failure cleanup to CLEANING. IA18-C requires attempt-local clean receipts and seals only attempt-local CANCELLED.
FailureCleanupCancellationCoordinatesV1 is declared equal to the IA18-F/IA18-C source union and pairwise disjoint by attempt source. No member may use IA16/IA17 or become a nonterminal sink.
IA09-IA15 and IA18-F/IA18-C are IX-dominant canonical stutters. No attempt row terminalizes the parent; IX03 and IX04 retain sole parent cleanup and CANCELLED ownership.

The required witnesses race IX01 immediately before and after IA16 and before IA17, include IX05 adoption, expected-version CAS/replay conflicts, byte-identical CleanupManifest preservation, and eventual IX04 only after attempt-local and full parent guards pass.

exact_text: IXH01-R, IXH01-Q, and IXH01-C accept HEALTHY reachable nonterminal cancellation tuples in REQUESTED, QUIESCING, and CLEANING respectively and atomically set health to TELEMETRY_DEGRADED while writing the deterministic generation/source-bound CancellationDegradationReceipt.

Each IXH row preserves exact candidate, rollout, release-attempt, Effect, rollback, cleanup, identity, and ownership coordinates; the cancellation fence stays active and no second saga or CleanupManifest is created.
ReachableCancellationDegradationCoordinatesV1 is declared exactly equal to the pairwise-disjoint IXH01-R/Q/C guard union. CANCELLED and every other terminal coordinate are absent.

The receipt identity binds parent_work_id, active_canary_generation, pre-event tuple digest, and degradation-event digest. Identical bytes replay; a conflicting digest or tuple version rejects. IX01/IX02 and Effect-settlement races use one tuple-version CAS and rederive the unique IXH/IX06 continuation.

exact_text: CancellationRevocationCoordinatesV1 is exactly the reachable REQUESTED/QUIESCING IX06 revocation relation over candidate sources SHADOW_PASSED, FROZEN, and EVIDENCE_STALE, partitioned by UNSETTLED, N, and X.
The exact guard union is IX06-UR/UQ, IX06-NR/NQ, and IX06-XR/XQ. Each revocation-triggered row maps SHADOW_PASSED|FROZEN|EVIDENCE_STALE to REVOKED, or preserves REVOKED on replay/continuation.

The six guards are pairwise disjoint after cancellation state and classifier are fixed. At IX01 their pre-cancel projection equals the corresponding IC32 guards: IC32 wins only while cancellation is NONE, IX06 wins after IX01, and a stale writer rejects by expected-version CAS.

The IX06 row preserves the exact Effect and any existing rollback identity/origin, creates no duplicate saga or cleanup, and retains the safe rollout target and branch owner for its X, N, or unsettled class.
